title: OOTD 디자이너 아트토이 피규어
body:
Generate a premium designer art toy / collectible vinyl figurine based on the provided reference photograph.

Preserve the person’s recognizable hairstyle, eyewear, outfit, accessories, colors, and overall OOTD styling.

Transform the person into a stylish, high-quality collectible vinyl figure with a slightly oversized head, sophisticated proportions, smooth sculpted surfaces, and realistic clothing details.

Present the collectible as a limited-edition product showcase featuring full-body views, close-up accessory details, transparent display base, premium retail packaging, and professional studio photography.

Include the title “MY DAILY FIGURE”, the label “LIMITED EDITION”, and the tagline “SAME FIT. SAME VIBE. DIFFERENT DIMENSION.”
